title: Mysterium Cosmographicum (Latin, 1596)
author: Johannes Kepler
description: Kepler's early cosmological work seeks a geometrical explanation for the arrangement of the planets. This Latin edition presents his model of nested Platonic solids within the intellectual setting of early modern astronomy.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/1596-kepler-prodromus-dissertationum-cosmographicarum-continens-mysterium-cosmographicum).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
